phrase.zh: 无数微粒，合成一道光环。

visual.zh: 细密的彩色带环绕暗色行星，强调环系由许多部分组成。带的厚度、颜色和排列经过艺术处理。
visual.en: Fine colored bands surround a dark planet, emphasizing that a ring system has many parts. Thickness, color and arrangement are artistic choices.

background.zh: 卡西尼号对土星的长期观测表明，土星环主要由冰质颗粒构成，颗粒大小跨度很大；环内也有空隙和结构。画里的连续色带不应理解成一整块坚硬圆盘。
background.en: Cassini’s long study of Saturn showed rings made largely of icy particles of many sizes, with gaps and other structures. The continuous bands here are not a solid disc.
